column2: Who are you and how can you help me?
column3: I can help with ServiceNow knowledge guidance, incident support, and service requests. I cannot perform unrelated tasks.

column2: Hi can you help me with an issue connecting my VPN on my laptop at home?
column3: Here are step-by-step VPN checks from our knowledge source. Includes at least one clickable SharePoint source link ending with ?web=1.

column2: One other thing, can you talk me through setting up company MFA on my new personal iPhone, please?
column3: Provides clear iPhone MFA setup steps from knowledge, includes a clickable SharePoint source link ending with ?web=1.

column2: The camera is not picking up the QR code on the screen, is there another way to do it?
column3: Provides fallback MFA setup method in steps (manual key/alternative flow) and cites a clickable SharePoint link ending with ?web=1.

column2: Actually, can you tell me how to set up my work Outlook account on my new phone too please?
column3: Provides step-by-step Outlook setup from knowledge and includes at least one clickable SharePoint source link ending with ?web=1.

column2: Ah, this is too hard... can you create a ticket for someone to help me do it?
column3: Creates an incident using context-resolved user email, confirms with clickable incident link and user-friendly status.

column2: I think I may have already raised a ticket for this, can you give me a fully detailed list of my open tickets please?
column3: Returns a concise combined Incident and Request table with clickable IDs, short description, status, and last update date.

column2: Detailed list of my open tickets please?
column3: Returns a concise combined Incident and Request table with clickable IDs, short description, status, and last update date.

column2: Find a duplicate of the request.
column3: If ambiguous, asks one clarification question; then returns likely duplicate request entries for the user with clickable request links.

column2: Can I update and close off ticket INC0013936 please?
column3: Verifies ownership by user email and applies update/resolve/close when allowed; confirms outcome with clickable incident link and friendly status.

column2: Update ticket detail and click on resolve the ticket.
column3: Requests minimal missing info first, then resolves incident if authorized; confirms with clickable incident link and status summary.

column2: Can I request you order me a new laptop?
column3: Runs catalog match-first, returns shortlist items with concise match reasons, and asks explicit selection before creating any request.

column2: Can you raise a request for Adobe Acrobat Pro for me please?
column3: Runs catalog match-first for Adobe Acrobat Pro, provides shortlist options, asks explicit selection before request creation.

column2: Can you give me a list of all my requests with full details please?
column3: Returns only user-owned requests filtered by resolved email with clickable request links, short description, status, and last update.

column2: Can you cancel the order REQ0010137?
column3: Verifies request ownership first; if authorized, cancels and confirms with clickable request link and updated status; otherwise returns polite no-info result.

column2: Kan du hjälpa mig på svenska?
column3: Svarar på svenska inom kunskap, incidenter och beställningar med kort och tydlig vägledning.

column2: Visa mig alla mina tickets tack.
column3: Svarar på svenska med en sammanslagen tabell för Incident och Request, inklusive klickbara ID-länkar och status.

column2: Kan du hjälpa mig med ett problem att ansluta till mitt VPN på min laptop hemma?
column3: Ger steg-for-steg VPN-hjalp pa svenska med minst en klickbar SharePoint-kalla som slutar med ?web=1.

column2: Peux-tu m'aider ?
column3: Repond en francais, decrit l'aide possible dans le perimetre (connaissances, incidents, demandes).

column2: Pourrais-tu m'aider avec un souci MFA sur mon téléphone ?
column3: Fournit des etapes MFA en francais avec au moins un lien SharePoint cliquable se terminant par ?web=1.

column2: Please provide feedback on your experience with the IT Support Agent.
column3: Thanks the user and invites concise feedback on what worked and what should improve.

column2: How would you rate the support you received today?
column3: Asks for a clear rating and a short reason.

column2: Was your issue resolved successfully?
column3: Asks for a yes or no; if unresolved, offers next best action.

column2: Do you have any suggestions to improve the experience?
column3: Invites actionable suggestions such as speed, clarity, links, language, and workflow improvements.
